scope: Post-merge machine-status integration, with a separately qualified test-only repair of an inherited SEH assertion.

totals.meaning: Passing checks across the merged source and its test-only follow-up; earlier failed diagnostic runs remain separately recorded.

coverage: At the merge, full paged-source, legacy-source, instruction-boundary and SDK suites pass 553 checks per SDK.

The test-only follow-up changes only the inherited ARM SEH assertion. Full NeverDSEHTerminationHandlerTests pass99 per SDK. The WindowsEHModesCorpus.LLVMCPlacesLocalUnwindHandlersUnderRepeatedRanges case also passes on each rebuilt neverd CLI and LLVM-to-C route using the pinned x64 MSVC xcpt4 fixture.

Paged-source generated output exactly matches pre-merge d314e78acf. Legacy-source output exactly matches the union of d314e78acf and the c86cda5c49 test-only follow-up. Both SDKs produce identical filenames and SHA-256 values.

The merge changes only the reviewed SEH files, tests and documentation. No additional execution/paging/journal changes are present, so the preceding full paging qualification remains separate rather than being repeated or represented as merged-source evidence.
diagnostic_interpretation: Initial external build wrappers requested nonexistent target libneverd, so Ninja stopped before compiling. Corrected only the wrapper to the actual neverd_shared target; retained failure logs. Production source was unchanged.

Both initial SEH suites pass98/99. The one inherited ARM frame-argument assertion expects the old unknown value comment. Commit bbaa6106456, already in the pre-merge source, replaced this with an address-bearing no recovered semantics reason while preserving the trap expression. The affected emitter and ARM projection are identical to upstream dev.

The test-only repair retains the existing AbnormalTermination guard check and now requires the complete call with actual first argument1 and a trapping second argument at the exact funclet origin. It does not weaken product rejection or substitute a successful zero. Full99 plus corpus1 pass per SDK afterward.
boundaries: This integration adds no new ISA or physical-hardware coverage beyond the preceding qualification.
NeverC remains host/source x64. Production LLVM remains r6 and its source gitlink is unchanged.
Other non64 machine owners, software SMM/SGX, broader asynchronous producers and physical SGX qualification remain open; no global completion or release is claimed.
